beamConclusion.decision: Do not preserve this beam slope when extending s03_02. Repaint only the exposed right beam to the reference's straight direction; preserve pillar, base and floor.
beamConclusion.reason: Smoothly bending or kinking s03_02 to meet both slopes would deform a straight architectural member. Any alternative that discards the conflicting beam pixels through coordinated overlap repaint is still a repair, not acceptance of a02 as-is.

upperJoin.geometry: Minimum-error source selection can retain continuous pillar sides and the visible right-beam edge; raw overlap disagreement alone does not prove the chosen composite has a broken edge.
upperJoin.materialIssue: A visible irregular wood-value transition remains across the pillar face. This is not corrected by the vertical join.
upperJoin.acceptance: not formally accepted; beam direction still conflicts with s02_02

lowerJoin.geometry: Stone joints and the red paper cluster remain continuous without a duplicated cluster or added obstacle.
lowerJoin.acceptance: usable candidate for this local join only
